title: 菊花賞の後に・堕ちゆく

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having lost to Narita Top Road in the Kikuka Sho, Admire Vega blames herself for focusing too much on her own feelings and forgetting her promise to her sister.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although I had been considering putting her in the Senior Spring Triple Crown, seeing her now makes me decide on the Takarazuka Kinen so that she'll have more time to rest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Narita Top Road notices Admire Vega's distress, but when she offers to help, she is quickly brushed off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Admire Vega has abandoned her rivalries and love of racing, choosing solitude instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In her mind, it's the only way she can remain faithful to her sister. She takes off into the darkness alone.
